description: Global @keyframes animations defined in sherpa-motion-classes.css. These are injected into every component shadow root by SherpaElement (via sharedStyles) so they are available inside shadow DOM. Do NOT reference them from light-DOM custom CSS — use the motion token custom properties (--sherpa-motion-duration-*, --sherpa-motion-easing-default) from sherpa-platform.css for durations. These keyframes are primarily consumed by specific Sherpa components and should not be applied to arbitrary elements.

keyframes.name: sherpa-grow-horizontal
keyframes.description: Grows an element's width from 0 to its natural width. Used by sherpa-barchart for bar enter animation.
keyframes.cssUsage: animation: sherpa-grow-horizontal var(--sherpa-motion-duration-base, 0.25s) var(--sherpa-motion-easing-default, ease-out) both;

keyframes.name: sherpa-grow-vertical
keyframes.description: Grows an element's height from 0 to its natural height.
keyframes.cssUsage: animation: sherpa-grow-vertical var(--sherpa-motion-duration-base, 0.25s) var(--sherpa-motion-easing-default, ease-out) both;

keyframes.name: sherpa-ripple-in
keyframes.description: Staggered opacity + slight horizontal slide reveal. Used by sherpa-nav-item for ripple-cascade entry of nav items. Combine with --_ripple-i index for staggered delay: animation-delay: calc(var(--_ripple-i, 0) * 30ms).

keyframes.name: sherpa-fade-in
keyframes.description: Simple opacity 0→1 fade. Used by sherpa-nav for content reveal on mount.
keyframes.cssUsage: animation: sherpa-fade-in var(--sherpa-motion-duration-fast, 0.15s) var(--sherpa-motion-easing-default, ease-out) both;

motionTokens.description: Motion duration and easing tokens are defined in tokens/sherpa-platform.css

notes: Do not add custom keyframes to page CSS that conflict with these names.
Prefer CSS transitions over animations for interactive state changes (hover, focus, active).
All motion respects prefers-reduced-motion: both reset.css (light DOM) and SherpaElement (shadow DOM) set transition-duration and animation-duration to 0.01ms when reduced motion is preferred.
To disable animation for a specific element: use animation:none or set transition-duration:0.
